Fog.Enable: Enable hex fog on this scene
Fog.ImageHint: Shown over unexplored hexes, stretched to cover the scene. Leave empty for black.
Fog.NotEnabled: Hex fog is off on this scene. Use the hexagon button first.
Fog.NeedsHexGrid: Hex fog requires a hexagonal grid scene.
Fog.ResetConfirm: Set all {count} marked hexes on this scene back to Unknown? This cannot be undone.
Fog.ResetNothing: No hexes are marked on this scene.

AutoReveal.Name: Reveal on party move
AutoReveal.Hint: Reveal the hex a party token moves into.

ShowTerrain.Name: Show terrain labels
ShowTerrain.Hint: Show hex terrain and road labels on hexes you have visited.

TrackTravel.Name: Track travel
TrackTravel.Hint: Charge hexploration activities to the day's budget when the party token enters a hex.

PartySpeed.Name: Party travel Speed (feet)
PartySpeed.Hint: Speed of the slowest party member. Ignored when pf2e-kingmaker-tools camping data is present.

HexSize.Name: Hex size (miles)
HexSize.Hint: Corner to corner. 12 is standard; smaller hexes give more activities per hex. Ignored when pf2e-kingmaker-tools camping data is present.

TerrainTint.Name: Terrain tint strength
TerrainTint.Hint: How strongly hexes are coloured while the Terrain tool is selected (0.1 to 1). Hexes under the fog are drawn about 1.8 times stronger so they stay visible.

Travel.Title: Travel Tracker
Travel.ForcedMarchCamping: Forced march (set on the camping sheet)
Travel.NoParty: No party token found on this scene.
